item.title: United Global Filipinos supports OFW cancer warriors in Abu Dhabi gift-giving event
item.description: Fifty overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) in Abu Dhabi battling cancer received gift packs during a special event organized by the United Global Filipinos of the 21st Century (UGFTC).
